house.description: Public water inventory temporary modifications prohibited, and report required.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to water; temporarily prohibiting modifications to the public water inventory; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+PUBLIC WATERS INVENTORY MODIFICATIONS MORATORIUM; REPORT. +]

[+(a) The commissioner of natural resources may not modify the public waters inventory under Minnesota Statutes, section 103G.201, until July 1, 2027. +]

[+(b) By January 15, 2027, the commissioner of natural resources, in consultation with counties, cities, townships, watershed districts, soil and water conservation districts, and other interested parties, must submit a report to the legislature on the public waters inventory modification process, including any necessary legislative changes, to ensure all modifications to the public waters inventory provide an opportunity for local government involvement and public comment. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to water; temporarily prohibiting modifications to the public water inventory; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. PUBLIC WATERS INVENTORY MODIFICATIONS MORATORIUM; REPORT.

(a) The commissioner of natural resources may not modify the public waters inventory under Minnesota Statutes, section 103G.201, until July 1, 2027.

(b) By January 15, 2027, the commissioner of natural resources, in consultation with counties, cities, townships, watershed districts, soil and water conservation districts, and other interested parties, must submit a report to the legislature on the public waters inventory modification process, including any necessary legislative changes, to ensure all modifications to the public waters inventory provide an opportunity for local government involvement and public comment.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
